label: late input h in a sequence that began with j
explanation: Sparse feature (about 0.01% of steps) that fires almost only in the late original phase (positions 6-8, mostly the last or second-to-last original token) plus a small tail at the <DEL> step. It never fires in the copy phase or at positions 0-4. The strongest activations are on input h at position 6-8 when the first original token is j (e.g. j a q e d g 0 [h]). The h & first=j & t>=6 conjunction gets dev P=0.44, R=0.39, mass recall 0.58, and covers 71% of the top activation quartile. What it misses: (1) weak activations on other tokens at the final original positions of j-initial sequences, and (2) weak activations on late h in sequences that do not start with j (late h without first=j: precision about 1.3%). It does not fire on h early in the sequence, and only rarely on late h when the first token is not j. Activations are larger for longer sequences (L=9 carries 69% of the mass).
